items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Then he said, he didn't have a room for us but he took us down to Miss Cotton's where the 'House of Meditation' was and had her to give us a room.

ctx.x: And he had a beautiful apartment up on St. Nicholas Avenue. We went directly to his apartment but he didn't have an extra bedroom. He didn't have room for us. Meanwhile, it was kind of late at night and he cooked dinner for us. It was on Sunday. I'll never forget, it was on a Sunday and they didn't have much left for dinner. But he cooked some other things for us and gave us a big dinner at that time of the night.
Then he said, he didn't have a room for us but he took us down to Miss Cotton's where the 'House of Meditation' was and had her to give us a room. And he gave Zutty some money.
Oh that was a good friend.
